headline: Expectations that China will resume refilling oil reserves at 400,000 barrels per day from November
summary: Newspaper Manchete reports expectations that China will restart filling its oil reserves at 400,000 barrels per day from November. The report is based on information available so far.
why: China is one of the world's largest crude oil importers, so changes in its stockpiling pace can shift global crude demand and prices. Brent is the main international benchmark for crude oil.
